summary: Iter257 backend-only regression for Stripe mode-aware price selection. All 4 unit tests in test_stripe_price_mode_iter257.py pass: _stripe_is_live() correctly detects sk_live_* keys, _price_for_plan() picks *_LIVE under live keys, falls back to base when _LIVE unset, and _plan_for_price() matches both live+test ids. Test-mode preview checkout still works: POST /api/payments/checkout for plan=solo AND plan=family both return 200 with a real Stripe cs_test_* Checkout Session URL — no regression from the mode switch. Unknown plan (e.g. 'enterprise') correctly returns 422 (Pydantic pattern), not 500/502. Iter256 access-state enforcement re-run: 12/13 passed; view_only writes still 402 with read_only marker, active/trial writes not blocked, and view_only can still POST /api/payments/checkout (reactivation gate preserved). The 1 unrelated failure is GET /api/documents for view_only user returning 409 no_household (fixture user has never onboarded a household — pre-existing seed-data issue, not caused by iter257 changes).

minor.issue: Returns 409 {error:no_household} instead of 200 because the view_only fixture has no household seeded. iter256 test expects 200 for view_only GETs. Fix by onboarding a household for this user or updating the test to accept 409 no_household. Unrelated to iter257 Stripe change.

action_items: Optionally: seed a household for cancelled.vo@example.com (or update iter256 test) so GET /api/documents returns 200 for view_only. Not blocking iter257.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/payments.py:_price_for_plan raises 400 for unknown plan, but the Pydantic pattern on CheckoutBody.plan intercepts first with 422 — the 400 branch is dead code for the checkout endpoint (still reachable from schedule_downgrade via DowngradeBody, which uses a narrower solo|family pattern, so also unreachable). Consider removing or noting.

routes/payments.py:294 catches stripe.error.StripeError and re-raises as 400. This is a good change — matches the review request. Note: portal, cancel, reactivate, and schedule-downgrade still return 502 on StripeError; consider harmonising to 400 too if desired.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing fixtures cathy@example.com and cancelled.vo@example.com.
